default_analysis_rule: exclude hours flagged flat-line (>= 6 identical h) or isolated spike, EXCEPT supported spikes (verified Diwali night 18:00-06:00, or corroborated by another clean same-city station within +-1 h at >= 50% of the value and > 2x the city median); exclude station-days where matched-hour PM2.5 > PM10 + max(20% x PM10, 20 ug/m3) (impossible); peer-outlier station-days are flagged, not excluded
